working_definition: T5a is one of four directional subtypes (a-d) of T5 neurons in the Drosophila optic lobe. It is a columnar, OFF-pathway, direction-selective neuron whose dendrites arborise in lobula layer Lo1 and whose axon terminals project specifically to lobula plate layer 1 (layer a). The four T5 subtypes encode cardinal directions of visual motion; T5a encodes the diagonal front-to-back direction read out in lobula plate layer 1.

best_match.fbbt_definition: T5 neuron with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1 (Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). It responds to motion in a diagonal front-to-back direction (Henning et al., 2022).

justification: FBbt:00003737 'T5a neuron' is defined as the T5 subtype with its lobula plate arbor in layer 1 that responds to diagonal front-to-back motion (Fischbach and Dittrich 1989; Henning et al. 2022). The atlas cluster 'T5a' is defined identically: a T5 (OFF-pathway) columnar optic lobe neuron whose axon terminals target lobula plate layer a (layer 1) and which encodes the corresponding cardinal direction of motion. The label, layer specificity, and directional tuning all match precisely. The FBbt term is not obsolete and is a direct subtype of T5 neuron (FBbt:00003736). FBbt further sub-divides T5a into T5ai (FBbt:00052245) and T5aii (FBbt:00052246) based on finer diagonal direction sub-tuning, but the atlas cluster 'T5a' does not resolve to that level of granularity; the cluster maps to the T5a level, not the sub-subtypes.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: Pre- versus postsynaptic innervation judged by scoring of terminal morphology from figures in Fischbach and Dittrich (1989) as assessed by FlyBrain Neuron DB. The neurotransmitter was assessed with a split-GAL4 strategy using a Chat-DBD allele (FBal0198074) (Mauss et al., 2014) and single-cell transcript profiling (Shinomiya et al., 2014). Connectivity in the lobula was assessed by serial section electron microscopy of a single column (Shinomiya et al., 2014).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Parent class covering all four T5 subtypes (a-d); the cluster 'T5a' is specifically the layer-1 subtype. Using the parent would be a broad match and would lose the defining layer-identity information that is central to this cluster's annotation.

other_candidates.fbbt_definition: T5a neuron that responds to motion in a diagonal upward front-to-back direction (Henning et al., 2022).
other_candidates.reason_rejected: Child of T5a neuron, representing a further sub-subtype defined by a specific diagonal sub-direction. The atlas cluster 'T5a' is not resolved to this level; this term is more specific than the cluster.

recommendation: Map cluster T5a to FBbt:00003737 (T5a neuron) with skos:exactMatch. The label, lobula plate layer-1 targeting, and direction-selectivity all correspond precisely. No new FBbt term is needed.
